text: Residents on Manitoba Street in Ward 6 submitted a petition in November 2017 to request the implementation of traffic calming, specifically speed humps, on Manitoba Street between Milton Street and Grand Avenue. An April 2018 report by Transportation Services in response to the petition found all of the warrant criteria for the installation of physical traffic calming were met except one.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District, to request the City Clerk to survey eligible householders in English or any other language specified by Community Council, on Manitoba Street, from Royal York Road to Grand Avenue to determine if property owners/occupants support the installation, according to the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the survey: a. Requested the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Manitoba Street, from Royal York Road to Grand Avenue, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on Drawing EY18-079.DGN, dated June 2018 and circulated to residents during the polling process. b. Directed Transportation Services take to the necessary actions to reduce the speed limit to 30 km/h on Manitoba Street, from Royal York Road…
